keyVerseDR: "The time is accomplished and the kingdom of God is at hand. Repent and believe the gospel." (Mk 1:15)

level1.title: Jesus in the Desert
level1.story: The Spirit led Jesus into the desert for 40 days. Satan tempted Him, and angels cared for Him. Jesus said, "Turn away from sin and believe the Good News!"
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How many days was Jesus in the desert?
What will you do for Lent?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me have a holy Lent. Amen.

activity.title: 40 days with Jesus
activity.intro: Stamp or draw a cross each day you pray, fast, or give.

level2.title: Repent and Believe
level2.story: Right after His baptism, the Spirit drove Jesus out into the desert. He was there forty days and forty nights, tempted by Satan. He was with the wild beasts, and the angels ministered to Him. After John was arrested, Jesus came into Galilee preaching the gospel of God. He said, "The time is accomplished, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent, and believe the gospel."
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why do we spend forty days in Lent?
level2.prayer: Jesus, help me turn back to You. Amen.

activity.title: Lent resolutions
activity.intro: Repent and believe! Write 3 resolutions for Lent.
starters: I will give to others by...
